components.name: Glass entry bay
components.function: Need glass wall/roof rib corner/entry assemblies, pond-floor/bed edging and hanging planter supports. Audit PAL-CONSERV-SURF subtype and reported differing floor/footrail before reuse; do not assume every conservatory shares it. Orchid/vine/fern forms and butterflies need local selection; no whole greenhouse model proven. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated glass entry bay matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
